scientific_question: Find a scientifically relevant coherent constant-density structure in the annular-combustor flow field. Construct the constant-Density isosurface at the 90th percentile of the finite stored Density values, treat each connected surface component as a candidate, and select the component with the largest surface area. Represent the selected surface by its area-weighted centroid and surface area, and report its centroid location, defining density value, and surface extent.
